accent.brand.blurb: The default: the suite's own colour.
accent.graphite.blurb: No colour at all. The floor carries it.
accent.midnight.blurb: Near-black with a hint of blue.
accent.olive.blurb: Earthy; sits well with the floor.
activate.activeBody: {tier}, up to {cap} people, billed with the rest of the suite. {n} people are in the directory today.
activate.askAdmin: Ask an admin or the owner to switch it on.
activate.manageBody: The tier, the user cap and billing belong to the suite. In the product this opens the billing page there; it is not part of this prototype.
activate.manageTitle: Plans are managed in the Business OS
activate.offBody: Team chat, calls and a virtual office, next to the work itself. The people, roles and entitlements come from the suite; nothing here needs setting up twice. A trial is fourteen days for the whole team, with no card.
activate.offTitle: Chats is not switched on for {ws}
activate.protoNote: Prototype: to show the switched-off state,
activate.recommendedHint: Fits the {n} people in the directory. Media minutes are the only cost that grows with use.
activate.trialBody: Everything is switched on for everyone in {ws}. When the trial ends, the workspace keeps its floor, channels and history, and the module waits until it is activated.
activate.unmeteredBody: Chats is managed per workspace. Only members with Chats access can open it; {n} people have access here.
activate.unmeteredHint: {n} people can use Chats in this workspace.
appearance.accentHint: Yours only, on this device. Teal, amber, violet and blue are reserved for presence, so they are not offered: an accent that looked like a status would be read as one.
availability.emptyDay: No shared approved absences for this day.
availability.error: Availability could not be loaded. Meetings are still shown.
availability.invalidTime: This time does not exist in the workspace timezone. Choose another start time.
availability.noMeetings: No meetings booked. Check availability before scheduling.
availability.title: Approved availability
boards.subtitle: A board without a meeting
boards.title: Whiteboard
calendar.freeBody: A clear day. Most conversations here do not need a meeting.
calendar.weekHint: Working hours only, {a}:00 to {b}:00. Pick a day to schedule on it.
call.cameraMissing: No camera found. Audio still works.
call.chatEmpty: Messages sent here stay with the meeting, and are still here afterwards.
call.consentBody: Everyone in the call, including guests, is shown a recording indicator for as long as it runs. Ask them out loud before you start.
call.consentPoint1: The recording is stored in Files, not in Chats.
call.consentPoint2: It follows the workspace retention setting like any other file.
call.consentPoint3: Anyone in the call can ask you to stop, and stopping is immediate.
call.endImpact: {people, plural, =0 {Nobody else is in the call.} one {One other person drops out of the call.} other {# other people drop out of the call.}} {guests, plural, =0 {} one {One guest drops out too.} other {# guests drop out too.}}
call.inviteBody: Send this link to anyone you want in the call.
call.readyBody: Send this link to whoever should be in it.
call.title: Meeting
card.deleted: {title} was deleted. The conversation is kept.
card.noPermission: This conversation is about a record you cannot open.
card.otherModuleBody: In the product, Open goes to the record in its own module of the Business OS. That module is not part of this prototype.
catchup.clearBody: Nothing is waiting on you. Anything new will show up here.
catchup.title: Catch up
channel.addPeopleDesc: They will see the full history of this channel.
channel.archiveBody: It leaves everyone's sidebar and nobody can post in it. The history stays searchable, and an admin can bring it back.
channel.archivedHint: Read-only and out of the list, but still searchable.
channel.archiveHint: Nobody can post; the history stays searchable. You can bring it back.
channel.createDesc: Channels are for a subject the whole team can follow. For one conversation about one record, use Discuss on the record instead.
channel.leaveBody: You will stop receiving messages from it. It stays searchable, and you can rejoin at any time because it is a public channel.
channel.nameRequired: Give the channel a name so people know what belongs in it.
channel.noFilesBody: Anything attached in this channel appears here, and in Files.
channel.noPinsBody: Pin a decision so it is still findable a month later.
channel.notifyAllHint: For the one or two channels you genuinely need to follow live.
channel.notifyMentionsHint: The default. Unread still shows, it just does not interrupt.
channel.notifyNoneHint: Silent, and dimmed in the sidebar so you remember you set it.
channel.privateDesc: Only invited people can find it, including in search.
channel.publicDesc: Anyone in the workspace can find and join it.
channel.renameHint: Links to the channel keep working; only the name changes.
channel.topicHint: Shown at the top of the channel and in search results
chat.archived: This channel is archived. It stays searchable.
chat.deleteBody: Everyone in the conversation sees a note that a message was removed, for a day. After that it disappears completely, including from search.
chat.emptyBody: Say something, or start the conversation from the task or invoice it is about.
chat.groupNameHint: Optional. Without one, the group is named after its people.
chat.linkCopiedBody: Anyone who can open this conversation can follow it.
chat.meetNowAll: Start a meeting with everyone in {name}
chat.newMessageDesc: One person opens a direct conversation. Two or more start a group.
chat.noChannelBody: It may have been archived or you may not be a member.
chat.notMemberBody: It's private. Ask one of its members to add you.
chat.startDm: This is the beginning of your conversation with {name}.
email.dmBody: Sara Lindqvist wrote to you while you were offline:
email.dmPre: Do you have ten minutes before the deploy?
email.intro: Four, and only while the person is away. Each says why it came and links to the setting that controls it. Switch the language to see the longer locales stretch the subject lines.
email.knockBody: Omar Haddad knocked at 14:12 while you were in Focus. The knock is held for you in Chats:
email.knockSubject: Omar knocked while you were in Focus
email.mentionBody: You were away when Inés Caballero mentioned you in #design at 10:26:
email.mentionPre: can you look at the empty state before I send this on?
email.reminderBody: Your meeting starts at 11:00 in Room A. Lena, Marc and Anna Baumgartner (guest) are invited.
email.reminderPre: Room A · with Lena, Marc and a guest from Baumgartner AG
email.reminderSubject: Baumgartner AG - invoice review starts in 10 minutes
email.settingsLink: Notification settings · Unsubscribe from this kind
email.title: The emails Chats sends
email.whyDm: Direct messages reach you by email only while you are offline, bundled if there are several.
email.whyKnock: A knock held during Focus is delivered when Focus ends. The email is a copy, in case you had left.
email.whyMention: You get an email for a mention only while you are offline. One per thread, at most every five minutes.
email.whyReminder: Ten minutes before a meeting you are invited to, unless you are already in Chats.
errors.crashBody: Something went wrong on our side. Try again, or go back to the office.
errors.notFoundBody: The link may be old, or the conversation or meeting may have been removed.
file.downloadBody: This prototype carries the file name and size, not the bytes. In the product the download comes from Files.
file.livesInManager: The document itself lives in Files, not in Chats. Sharing it in a conversation points at the same file rather than making a copy, so there is never a second version to reconcile.
file.managerBody: Files live in the Files tool of the Business OS. Chats only ever points at them, so in the product this opens there.
file.managerTitle: Files is not in this prototype
file.name: Name
focus.held: Here is what was held while you were heads down.
guest.admittedBody: The host admitted you. Your microphone is live.
guest.declinedBody: They may be in a different conversation, or the meeting may have moved. You can ask again, or check with them directly.
guest.declinedTitle: The host did not let you in this time
guest.endedBody: You can close this tab. Nothing was installed and no account was created.
guest.expiredBody: The meeting has finished, or the link has expired. Ask your host for a new one.
guest.expiredTitle: This link is no longer active
guest.leftBody: You can close this tab. Nothing was installed and no account was created.
guest.lobbyBody: We have told the host you are here. This usually takes a moment.
guest.lobbyBodyNamed: Thanks, {name}. We have told the host you are here. This usually takes a moment.
guest.lookingBody: Checking that the link is still active.
guest.subtitle: {time}. Hosted by {workspace}.
guest.trust: No account needed. Nothing to install.
inactivity.body: No input for {n} minutes. To protect the workspace you will be signed out in {s} s. Any movement or key keeps you here.
inactivity.bodyComputer: Your computer has seen no input for {n} minutes. To protect the workspace you will be signed out in {s} s. Any movement or key keeps you here.
inactivity.title: Still there?

insights.exportedBody: {n} days of team totals as CSV.
insights.exportedMineBody: {n} days, yours only. Nothing was sent anywhere.
insights.fromTheWorkBody: The product's promise is that conversations attach to the work. These two say whether that is happening.
insights.guestsMeta: guests who joined a call by link

insights.heatNoteMe: Averaged across the period. Your busiest hour: {day} at {hour}:00.
insights.kpiActive: People here on a working day
insights.lengthsBody: Hours spent, by how long each meeting was booked for.

insights.meetingTrendAlt: Hours in meetings over the period
insights.meetingTrendBody: Meeting time on the calendar, for meetings this group took part in.
insights.mentionsOf: typical time to the first reply, over {n} mentions
insights.myRhythmBody: How much of each hour of the week you were here, on average.
insights.myTimeBody2: Your own numbers for the same period. Nobody else can open this view of you, and no manager has an equivalent.
insights.myTrendAlt: Your hours here over the period
insights.notForRole: Insights is not part of the {role} role
insights.notForRoleBody: It describes the team as a whole and is for people who are part of it. A guest is in one meeting and nothing else.
insights.objectShare: Threads started from a Business OS object
insights.objectShareCaption: {a} of {n} threads. The line marks the 30% the product is aiming for.
insights.preamble: Everything here describes the people you picked as a group. There is no view of an individual person, for anyone, including admins. Groups smaller than {n} are not shown at all.
insights.preambleMe: These are your own numbers. Nobody else can open this view of you, and no manager has an equivalent.
insights.presentTrendBody: Time signed in and here, summed across the group.
insights.roomUseBody2: Hours each room was occupied over the period, meetings and quiet work alike.
insights.sizesTakeaway: Most meeting time went to groups of {band}, at {pct}% of {total}.
insights.title: Insights
insights.tooFew: Not enough members to show team numbers. At least {n} are needed.
insights.tooFewPicked: {n} people is below the minimum of {min}, so nothing is shown.
insights.tooFewWhy: With a group this small an average is a person. Add people until the group is at least {min}, or choose Only me to see your own numbers.
insights.trendAlt: Team meeting hours over {n} weeks, from {a} to {b}
insights.utilisationBody: Hours the rooms were occupied against the hours they were available, across the working week.
insights.utilisationHigh: Close to full. People are probably taking calls at their desks because nothing was free.
insights.utilisationLow: There is room to spare. Adding meeting rooms would not help; the constraint is somewhere else.
insights.utilisationOk: Comfortable. Rooms are being used without anyone queuing for one.
meetings.copyBlocked: This browser blocked copying. The link is selected: press Ctrl+C or Cmd+C.
meetings.descriptionPlaceholder: A line for the people invited, and for the summary afterwards.
meetings.endedBody: Its notes and anything shared in it stay with the meeting.
meetings.guestHint: They join from a link, with no account
meetings.linkBranding: The page carries your branding, never a third party's.
meetings.linkLead: Send this link to anyone outside the workspace.
meetings.linkLobby: They need no account, and they wait in the lobby until someone in the call lets them in.
meetings.linkOpen: They need no account, and they join straight away.
meetings.missingBody: The link may be old, or the meeting may have been cancelled.
meetings.noneBody: Most conversations here do not need a meeting. Knock on someone instead.
meetings.peopleHint: From the directory. You are in it already.
meetings.processingHint: It appears in Files when it is done.
meetings.repeatsWeekly: Repeats weekly. Each week is its own meeting, with its own notes.
meetings.resetImpact: The current link stops working for anyone who has it. Guests already in the meeting stay. Share the new link with whoever should still join.
meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.titleRequired: Give the meeting a title so people know what it is.
meetings.turnIntoTask: Turn a decision into a task
meetings.weeklyLabel: Repeats weekly, for the next four weeks

office.canvas: Office floor. Walk with the arrow keys or W A S D; entering a room connects its audio. Rooms and people are also focusable: Enter opens, Escape leaves.
office.deskHint: Open floor. Audio connects in rooms, not here.
office.dragHint: Drag to move, or walk with the arrow keys
office.firstBody: The floor fills as people sign in. Until then, set a status so they know how to find you, or bring the rest of the team in.
office.firstTitle: You are the first one in today
office.focusUntil: In focus. A knock is held and delivered when they finish.
office.hiddenRoom: This room does not name who is inside
office.hoverHidden: {n} inside. This room does not name who.
office.knockingBody: You will hear when they answer. During Focus a knock is held and delivered later.
office.minimap: Map of the whole floor. Click to look there.
office.mobileNote: The floor plan is a desktop view. Everyone is listed here, grouped by room.
office.moderationNote: Mute mic and Deafen apply for everyone, and the person is told.
office.title: Office
office.walkHint: walk · click to go · space-drag to pan · ctrl-scroll to zoom
people.needMore: {n} selected. Team numbers need at least {min}, or only you.
people.title: Choose people
prejoin.cameraDenied: Your browser blocked the camera. You can still join with audio.
prejoin.cameraMissing: No camera found. You can still join with audio.
prejoin.cameraOff: Camera is off. Meetings here are audio-first.
prejoin.micDenied: Microphone blocked. Others will not hear you until you allow it.
prejoin.nameHint: Shown to everyone in the meeting
prejoin.recordingNotice: This meeting may be recorded. You will be asked before it starts.
prejoin.saySomething: Say something to check the level.
profile.noHistory: There is no activity history here. Nothing is recorded about a person that they cannot see about themselves.
range.customHint: Or pick two days on the right.
range.title: Choose a period
role.admin.blurb: Can change the floor and settings, archive channels, and moderate.
role.guest.blurb: One meeting, by link. Sees nothing else of the workspace.
role.member.blurb: The everyday role. Can do their work; cannot change the workspace.
role.owner.blurb: Everything an admin can do, plus resetting the workspace. Cannot be removed by an admin.
role.prototypeOnly: A prototype control. In the real product the role comes from your Business OS account and nobody can change their own.
room.addDesc: It is placed in the first free space on the floor and appears for everyone at once.
room.audioHint: Off makes it a quiet room: presence, no microphone.
room.audioKindOff: This kind of room never opens a microphone.
room.capacityHardHint: Nobody beyond this number can enter.
room.capacityHint: The room shows as full beyond this, but nobody is blocked.
room.chatEmpty: Notes left here stay with the room, and are still here tomorrow.
room.guestsHint: A meeting booked here can carry a guest link.
room.hardCapHint: Refuse entry beyond capacity instead of only labelling the room full.
room.hoursHint: Outside them the room is closed and cannot be entered.
room.kindFurniture: Changing the kind refurnishes the room.
room.lockedHint: People knock instead of walking in. Useful for a one to one.
room.name: Name
room.nameRequired: A room needs a name people can say out loud.
room.noSpace: There is no space left on the floor for a room of this kind. Remove one first, or switch to a larger template.
room.purposeHint: One line, shown when the room is empty and on hover
room.removeBody: The room disappears from the floor for everyone. Its name can be reused.
room.removeBodyOccupied: {n} people are in it right now. They will be put back on the open floor, and any audio in the room ends.
room.settingsDesc: Everyone on the floor sees these immediately.
room.showOccupantsHint: Off shows a count on the floor and no tiles. For rooms where privacy matters.
roomKind.boardroom.hint: The big table. Clients may join by link
roomKind.booth.hint: One person, one call. Full means full
roomKind.wellness.hint: Rest. Quiet, and nobody is named inside
search.noneBody: Try fewer words, or search for the person who would have said it.
search.startHint: Type above to search messages, files and people you can see.
search.title: Search
settings.accessBody: These narrow what members may do. Admins and the owner keep everything; a guest never gains anything here.
settings.autoAwayHint: Minutes without any input. Focus and meetings are never interrupted by this.
settings.channelNotifyHint: The starting level for channels created from now on. Anyone can change it per channel.
settings.daylightHint: The floor is lit by the time of day: warm in the morning, amber in the evening.
settings.directoryNote: Chats does not keep its own list of people. Adding someone, removing them, or changing a role happens once, in the Business OS, and applies to all seven modules.
settings.earshotHint: How close two people must be on the open floor to hear each other at full level. The bubble is drawn at the same distance.
settings.editWindowHint: After this the edit option stops being offered. Deleting is always possible.
settings.emailsHint: Four, only while a person is away: a mention, a message, a missed knock, a reminder.
settings.exportHint: Settings, floor, channels, messages and meetings as one JSON file. Presence is not in it: there is no history of where anyone was.
settings.focusDefaultHint: Offered first when someone goes into Focus.
settings.guestHint: Clients join meetings with no account. Guest data is kept to a name and an optional email.
settings.hoverCardsHint: Who is in a room, before you walk in.
settings.idleDenied: Blocked in the browser's site settings for this address, so only activity inside Chats can be seen. Allow it there to watch the computer.
settings.idleGranted: The computer reports whether it has seen any input, and nothing else. Working in another window counts as being here.
settings.idleMotionHint: People breathe at rest. Off holds them still; the system's reduce-motion setting also turns it off.
settings.idlePrompt: Chats asks the browser for this on your first click. Until it is allowed, only activity inside Chats can be seen. The computer answers idle or not, never what you were doing.
settings.idleUnsupported: This browser cannot report the computer's activity, so only activity inside Chats can be seen. Chrome, Edge and the desktop app can.
settings.inactivityHint: Minutes without mouse, keyboard or touch. The last minute is announced with a countdown; a live meeting counts as being here.
settings.intConnected: Connected as {account}. Its meetings appear in the list.
settings.intConnecting: Waiting for the calendar to answer.
settings.integrationsBody: A connected calendar puts its meetings in the list, opens outside links in one press, and sets In a meeting from the calendar.
settings.intError: The connection expired. Reconnect to see its meetings again.
settings.languageHint: Yours alone, and the same in every OrgTik tool.
settings.lobbyHint: Manual keeps a client waiting until someone admits them. Auto lets them straight in.
settings.manageBody: The directory belongs to the suite, not to Chats. In the product this opens the people page there; it is not part of this prototype.
settings.manageTitle: People are managed in the Business OS
settings.minCohort: Insights need a group of at least
settings.minCohortHint: Below this, team numbers are hidden. It cannot go under five: with a group that small, an average is a person.
settings.planActive: Activated. The tier and user cap come from the suite.
settings.planTrial: On trial, {n} days left. Activation and billing live in the suite.
settings.quietHint: The default. Everything else arrives as a digest instead of an interruption.
settings.quietHoursHint: Nothing interrupts you between these times. Knocks are held and delivered when the window closes, so nothing is lost - it just waits.
settings.readOnly: You are viewing as {role}. These are the workspace's settings; only an admin or the owner can change them.
settings.recordingHint: Everyone in the call is asked before a recording starts. Recordings are stored in Files.
settings.resetBody: Every change anyone has made - rooms, channels, messages, statuses - goes back to the opening state. This cannot be undone.
settings.resetHint: Puts every room, channel, message and status back to the opening state. In this prototype that is the demo's starting point; in the product it would be a full export first.
settings.retentionHint: Deleting reaches the search index and stored media, not just the screen.
settings.runSetupHint: The five-step guide from the first day: name, floor, rooms, people, defaults. Nothing is changed until you finish it.
settings.soundsHint: Four sounds: knock, join, leave and mention. Nothing else makes a noise.
settings.templateLegend: Choose the layout that fits the team. You can change it later.
settings.title: Chats settings
settings.transparencyBody: Every member can read exactly what Chats records about them. The page reflects the settings above as you change them.
settings.workspaceNameHint: On the guest page your clients see.
setup.adminsOnlyBody: It changes the floor and the workspace for everyone. Ask an admin, or the owner.
setup.defaultsBody: Both can be changed in settings, and both matter more than they look.
setup.guests: Let clients join meetings by link
setup.guestsHint: They join with no account, and see your name rather than ours.
setup.nameBody: It appears on the guest page your clients see, so use the name they know you by.
setup.next1b: Your status goes Available across all seven modules, and the team can see you are there.
setup.next2: Start one conversation from a record
setup.next2b: Open a task or an invoice and press Discuss. That is the habit the whole module is built around.
setup.next3: Knock on someone instead of scheduling
setup.next3b: A two minute question should not become a calendar invite.
setup.peopleBody: These come from your Business OS directory, so there is no second list to keep up to date. Everyone is included by default.
setup.quiet: Only mentions and direct messages notify people
setup.quietHint: The alternative is notifying on everything, which is how a workspace becomes the thing people mute.
setup.readyBody: Three things worth doing in the first day, in this order.
setup.roomsBody: People say these out loud all day. Names that match how the team already talks work best.
setup.templateBody: You can rename rooms, change how many there are, and switch template later.
setup.templateTitle: Pick a floor to start from
shell.noNotifications: Nothing waiting. You are up to date.

signedOut.inactiveComputer: Your computer reported no input for {n} minutes, so Chats ended the session to protect the workspace.

signedOut.title: Signed out

status.focus.desc: Knocks are held and delivered afterwards. Nothing is lost.
status.in_meeting.desc: In a room with other people. You can walk in.
status.noteHint: Press Enter to save it with your current status, or pick a new status below.

suite.viewingAsBy: Started from {name}'s account. You can look around; changes are turned off, and this visit is recorded.

toast.roomFullBody: It takes {capacity}, and {inside, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} in it. Try another room, or wait.
trans.colleaguesDesc: Your current status, your custom note, and which room you are in. Nothing historical.
trans.footer: You can ask an admin for a copy of your data or for it to be deleted. Deleting reaches the search index and any stored recordings, not just the screen.
trans.inactivityOn: {n} minutes without input, measured on your device
trans.intro: This page describes the actual settings of this workspace, not a general policy. If an admin changes a setting, this page changes with it.
trans.managersDesc: Team totals only, and only for groups of {n} or more. There is no screen anywhere in this product that shows one person's history to someone else.

trans.messagesWhy: So conversations can be found again.
trans.noContent: Any analysis of what your messages say

trans.noScores: Productivity scores, for you or anyone
trans.presence: When you are signed in and available

trans.roomWhy: So people can walk in and join a conversation.
trans.thirtyDays: 30 days as events, then only weekly totals
trans.threshold: Minimum group size for team numbers

trans.youDesc: Everything about yourself, including your own weekly hours.

workspace.noAccess: Chats is unavailable in this workspace
